steps.headline: After downloading, can you set up this plugin across several projects without losing track?
steps.changed: The newly installed plugin appears once inside each project's expandable card. All three projects start with it off; turning it on offers the skill and server switches.
steps.notice: Choose different parts for Your Assistant, Personal and School notes. Closing the page leaves the download installed, even if every project stays off.
steps.risk: This is a layout preview using an illustrative Research Kit, not a real download. Its switches and confirmation are local examples; they save nothing yet. The surrounding Projects screen is not rendered here.

steps.headline: For an existing project, can you tell what is automatic and what you can change?
steps.changed: The project lists installed plugins with their automatic-use switches. Chat Search, Page Builder and Marketplace Publisher start on; Theme Builder and a new download start off.
steps.notice: Open a plugin to inspect its individual items. Changing a switch affects new conversations, not a conversation already open.
steps.risk: This preview isolates the controls, not the full Projects page or command drawer. It uses sample data, and nothing you click saves or changes the running app.
